children: Ribbon Acquisition unveiled a suite of financing arrangements with Meteora to support its business combination with DRC Medicine. The package includes a $100 million Standby Equity Purchase Agreement, a $1,212,121 prepaid convertible note funded at $1,000,000, an OTC equity prepaid forward for up to 4.1 million shares with a $10.00 reference price reset mechanism, a subscription agreement to source additional shares, and registration rights to enable resales. Together, the facilities are designed to address potential redemptions, enhance post-close liquidity, and provide flexible capital access.
Agreement 1: Ribbon Acquisition Enters $100 Million Standby Equity Purchase Agreement With Meteora
: Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (equity facility up to $100 million)
: 36 months, extendable by up to 24 months
Agreement 2: Ribbon Acquisition Issues $1.21 Million Prepaid Convertible Note; Receives $1.0 Million
: Provide near-term funding with equity convertibility
Agreement 3: Ribbon Acquisition Strikes Prepaid Forward for Up to 4.1M Shares Around $10 Reference Price
: OTC Equity Prepaid Forward Transaction (up to 4.1M shares)
: Meteora Select Trading Opportunities Master and DRC Medicine
: Cash settlement ~6 months post-closing, extendable by consent
: Mitigate redemption impact and support post-close liquidity
Agreement 4: Ribbon Acquisition Signs Subscription Agreement to Supply Additional Shares Under Forward
: Through forward’s settlement and any replacements
: Ensure share supply for forward and note mechanics
Agreement 5: Ribbon Acquisition Grants Registration Rights for SEPA, Note and Forward Shares
: Registration Rights Agreement for resale of underlying shares
: Facilitate liquidity and compliance for share resales
